courses_career_slot_check.name: courses_career_slot_check
courses_career_slot_check.value: ("members"."courses"."level"::text <> 'primeiros-passos' or "members"."courses"."track"::text = '2d') and ("members"."courses"."career_slot" is null or ("members"."courses"."audience" = 'kids' and "members"."courses"."level"::text <> 'lenda' and "members"."courses"."career_slot" between 1 and (case when "members"."courses"."level"::text = 'primeiros-passos' then 1 else 8 end)))

creations_usage_idx.name: creations_usage_idx
creations_usage_idx.where: "members"."creations"."deleted_at" is null and "members"."creations"."storage_ref" is not null
